def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

    priorities = np.full(n, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    if n == 0:
        return priorities
    valid_mask = bins >= item

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    n = len(bins)
    priorities = np.full(n, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    indices = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    priorities[valid_mask] = (bins[valid_mask] - item) / indices[valid_mask]
    return priorities
